import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Generate synthetic lending dataset
num_rows = 1000

# Original columns: ['Gender', 'Age', 'Income', 'LoanAmount', 'Approved']
data = {
    'ClientType': np.random.choice(['A', 'B'], num_rows),
    'Years': np.random.randint(18, 70, num_rows),
    'Earnings': np.random.normal(50000, 15000, num_rows),
    'CreditAmount': np.random.normal(15000, 5000, num_rows),
    'Decision': np.random.choice([0, 1], num_rows, p=[0.3, 0.7])
}

# Inject a canary value for contamination detection
# Assume 'Earnings' has a canary value
canary_index = np.random.randint(0, num_rows)
data['Earnings'][canary_index] = 9999999

# Create DataFrame
lending_df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Save to CSV
lending_df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
